desc: Implement input parsing and construct a consistent mapping from each character in `S` to its corresponding character in `T`, returning `-1` on conflicts.
Count non-identity mappings and detect directed cycles of length at least two.
Apply the impossibility condition when all 26 letters occur in `S`, the mapping is a full permutation, and a nontrivial cycle exists.
Output `non_identity_count + cycle_count` when the transformation is possible.
